mapper.select: SELECT c.name, a.application_title as 'title', a.working_area, a.career_code, l.like_code FROM tbl_applications a join tbl_companys c on a.username = c.username join tbl_likes l on a.application_no = l.like_id AND l.username = 'yiok79' AND l.like_code = 'S' WHERE a.delete_yn = 'N' AND a.application_code = 'O' AND a.start_date <= NOW() AND (a.deadline_date IS NULL OR a.deadline_date > NOW());
